---
applyTo: "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,java,kt,py,go,cs,rs,sql,xml,yml,yaml,json,toml,properties}"
---
# Source Analysis Rules
Identify symbols, callers, dependencies, side effects, boundaries, validation, state transitions, persistence, transactions, errors/retries, and supporting tests. Record precise evidence. Never infer business intent from names alone. Never expose secret values.
